title: Grouping with GroupBy & ToLookup
description: Learn to group elements by key values using GroupBy and create lookups with ToLookup.

data.text: Grouping operators create groups of elements based on a given key, similar to the GROUP BY clause in SQL.

rows: Returns groups of elements based on a key value. Each group is an IGrouping<TKey, TElement> object.
Same as GroupBy, but with immediate execution. Only available in method syntax.

data.text: The `GroupBy` operator returns groups of elements from a collection based on a key value. Each group is represented by an `IGrouping<TKey, TElement>` object with a `.Key` property and an inner collection of elements.

data.title: GroupBy in Query Syntax
GroupBy in Method Syntax

data.text: `ToLookup` is the same as `GroupBy`, with one key difference: `GroupBy` uses **deferred execution**, while `ToLookup` uses **immediate execution**.

data.title: Query Syntax Not Supported
data.text: ToLookup is only available in method syntax and is not supported in query syntax.

data.title: ToLookup Example

data.caption: GroupBy vs ToLookup execution
data.definition:
graph TB
    A[GroupBy] --> B[Deferred Execution]
    B --> C[Query executes when iterated]
    D[ToLookup] --> E[Immediate Execution]
    E --> F[Query executes immediately]

terms.definition: Represents a collection of objects that share a common key. Has a Key property and can be iterated.
Groups elements by a key with deferred execution. Available in query and method syntax.
Groups elements by a key with immediate execution. Only available in method syntax.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: GroupBy creates groups of elements based on a key
Each group has a Key property and inner collection
ToLookup uses immediate execution and is method syntax only
